stem: The American faces the challenge of —

options.label: A
options.text: making sure the hostess doesn’t stay quiet longer than he does

options.label: B
options.text: keeping the guests quiet until the cobra leaves the room

options.label: C
options.text: calming his fear of snakes in order to capture the cobra

options.label: D
options.text: learning Indian social etiquette so that he will be respected by the other guests
